house.summary: Compare the life improvement against the financial and moving cost before falling in love with a listing.
priorities: More flexible family and guest space
A yard that supports play, gardening, and maintenance access
A purchase that leaves room for ordinary life and future projects

scenarios.name: Stay and improve
scenarios.detail: Lowest disruption; continue targeted improvements while watching the market.

scenarios.name: Move for a clear upgrade
scenarios.detail: Act only when space, location, and long-term fit are meaningfully better.

scenarios.name: Stretch for the perfect fit
scenarios.detail: Worth considering only when the trade-offs are explicit and reversible.

next_steps: Write the shared must-have and nice-to-have list
Compare monthly cost using the same assumptions
Record one decision note after each serious property
